fields.System.Title: INV-602 — Query stock by batch
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector handling a recall, I want to find every unit of a batch, so that
I can quarantine what is here and identify who received what has gone.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a batch number, when I query it, then I get every location holding it with
  • quantities and status.
  • - Given the same batch, then I can also list every movement of it, including shipments.
  • - Given a shipped batch, then I can identify the orders and customers it went to.
  • - Given the query, then it covers stock in every status, not just available.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, outbound |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement, batch |
| Risks | Incomplete batch traceability makes a recall unanswerable ([doc 05 WF 14](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
